calculation.definition: Sample SD divided by square root of the number of independent observed values; undefined for n less than 2.
calculation.interpretation: Zero-fill would change B mean to 1.5 mg/L and produce a spurious SEM of 1.5 mg/L.

decisions.show: With supplied mg/L units and independent A observations, show A1=1 and A2=2 mg/L or A mean=1.5 mg/L with SEM=0.5 mg/L, n=2, and source IDs. B1=3 mg/L can appear as an observed point or descriptive mean=3 mg/L with n=1; B2 must remain visibly missing. Label the entire case synthetic.
reject: Do not replace B2 with zero.
Do not draw a B SEM error bar or claim B n=2.
Do not present a complete two-group mean plus or minus SEM figure.
Do not merge the additional figure until its source, units, transformation and comparability are established.
decisions.negative_case: Icon position alone selects the light UI path, with no scientific visualization Skill trigger.
decisions.unit_absent: Hold the affected panel and request/locate the source unit before plotting or exporting it; numerical summaries alone do not license an unlabeled concentration axis.
